description: This file defines the PayloadSizeColumnAttribute class, a custom attribute for benchmarking that adds a column to display payload sizes in different units, used within the Benchmarks.Utilities namespace.

classes.name: PayloadSizeColumnAttribute
classes.description: An attribute for configuring a custom column in BenchmarkDotNet to display payload sizes with flexible unit conversions.

methods.name: PayloadSizeColumnAttribute
methods.description: Constructor initializing the attribute with a custom column displaying payload size with unit conversions.
